artifact_scope: Raw execution directories and compact reports, including duplicate compact copies. Source and ordinary repository checkout/Git machinery are not run artifacts.
scope: Cumulative numerical trial CPU and recorded phase wall, including both versions, fixtures, failed freeze, development, confirmation, repeat, analysis, figures, audit and final packaging. Wall is summed executed-phase time, not elapsed chat time. Repository tests and language-model assistance are separate engineering work under the frozen protocol.
trial_timestamp_limit: See execution-index.json: status-file modification times only; no separate absolute start/end timestamps were recorded.
